HAPPY BIRTHDAY TAWA

Thirty years of you I hope you know how incredibly special you are, not just today but every other single day.

Thank you for all the memories, the laughs, the cuddles, the arguments we somehow survive, and all the little moments that have become some of my favourite parts of life.

Watching you grow into the man you are today makes me so proud. I hope this new chapter brings you everything you deserve: happiness, success, peace, unforgettable adventures, and plenty of reasons to smile.

And just so we’re clear… turning 30 doesn’t mean you’re getting rid of me. Sorry. 😭😂❤️

Here’s to 30 years of YOU, and hopefully many, many more years of me loving you, annoying you, laughing with you, and reminding you that you’re stuck with me.


I love you more than words, more than I can explain, and probably more than you deserve after all the nonsense you put me through. 😂

Forever your Samy. ❤️
